# Alireza Rogni (AlirezaRg / Codeiish)

> Backend & systems engineer. Python, Flask, Django, Odoo/ERP integrations, Linux administration, and Claude Code CLI powered AI tooling. Builds backends that don't fall over and bridges hardware/systems that were never meant to talk to each other.

Alireza Rogni is a backend developer and Linux administrator, founder of Codeiish, based remotely and working worldwide. Core focus areas: Python backend services (Flask, Django), Odoo 18 / ERP integrations, biometric hardware bridges over WebSocket, Linux server administration (Debian, systemd, Nginx), and small AI-powered developer tools built on Claude Code CLI.

Two client projects are not open source and have no public repository: a Flask middleware bridging ST-Face biometric devices to Odoo 18 over WebSocket, and Omid Market, a full Django e-commerce app with ZarinPal payments and RTL support.

## Projects

- [Rasco-Gosi](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/Rasco-Gosi): JARVIS-style desktop AI assistant using Claude Code CLI as its reasoning engine
- [Ex-Changes-Code](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/Ex-Changes-Code): AI-powered code translator across 13 programming languages via Claude Code CLI
- [code-analysis](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/code-analysis): AI-powered codebase search and file explainer
- [hand-mouse-control](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/hand-mouse-control): webcam hand-tracking mouse control via MediaPipe
- [cv-playground](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/cv-playground): real-time face detection/recognition with InsightFace and ArcFace
- [pdf-insurance-to-excel](https://github.com/AlirezaRg/pdf-insurance-to-excel): converts Iranian insurance PDF reports to Excel, with OCR
